objectives.en: Say every fact from ten times one to ten times twelve without help.
objectives.yo: Sọ gbogbo fact láti ten times one dé ten times twelve láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Talk every fact from ten times one reach ten times twelve without help.

objectives.en: Answer any ten times fact out of order.
objectives.yo: Dáhùn èyíkéyìí ten times fact láìtẹ̀lé ètò.
objectives.pcm: Answer any ten times fact wey no follow order.

curriculum.note: NERDC's primary ceiling is 9 x 9; no class requires this table. Kept as enrichment after Primary 3.

say.en: Look at three groups of ten mangoes. Today we count in tens.
say.pcm: Look three groups of ten mango. Today we go count ten ten.
say.yo: Wo groups three ti ten mango. Lónìí a ó kà ní ten ten.

say.en: Today you will learn the ten times table. Then you will say it by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go learn table ten. Then you go talk am by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò kọ́ table ten. Lẹ́yìn náà, ìwọ yóò sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.

say.en: Do you remember the nine times table? What is nine times four?
say.pcm: You remember table nine? Nine times four na how much?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí table nine? Kí ni nine times four?

say.en: Three groups of ten mangoes show this. We count ten, twenty, thirty. Ten times three is thirty.
say.pcm: See three groups of ten mango: ten, twenty, thirty. Ten times three na thirty.
say.yo: Wo groups mẹ́ta ti ten mango: ten, twenty, thirty. Ten times three jẹ́ thirty.

say.en: Say it with me: ten times three is thirty.
say.pcm: Say am with me: ten times three na thirty.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ mi: ten times three jẹ́ thirty.

say.en: Say the ten times table. Start with ten times one. End with ten times twelve.
say.pcm: Say table ten. Start with ten times one. End with ten times twelve.
say.yo: Sọ table ten. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ten times one. Parí pẹ̀lú ten times twelve.

say.en: Let us fix the ones you missed. Listen, then say them with me.
say.pcm: Make we fix the ones you miss. Hear them, then say them with me.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn tí o pàdánù ṣe. Gbọ́, lẹ́yìn náà sọ wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ mi.

say.pcm: Ten times seven na how much?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we check the ten times table once more. Then we start the eleven times table.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go check table ten again. Then we start table eleven.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ṣàyẹ̀wò table ten. Lẹ́yìn náà a ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ table eleven.
